title: Add a mobile navigation menu
description: The main navigation is crowded on small screens. Look at components/Shell.js. It is fixed when mobile users can reach every route comfortably.
how: Open the app at a narrow width and navigate to every main page.

title: Improve post card contrast
description: Some post metadata is difficult to read. Look at app/globals.css.
how: All post text meets an accessible contrast check.

title: Add keyboard focus styles to every control
description: Review buttons, links, and form fields for visible keyboard focus.
how: Tab through each page and always see the focused control.

title: Add initials fallback for avatars
description: Profiles should stay recognizable when an image is missing.
how: A missing avatar displays useful initials.

title: Format dates consistently
description: Replace raw date strings with a shared friendly date helper.
how: Events and posts use readable local dates.

title: Sort events by upcoming date
description: Past events should not appear before upcoming events.
how: Upcoming events are first and past events are separated.

title: Add feed empty states
description: Show a helpful message when filters find no resources.
how: A no-results filter has a clear empty state.

title: Make feed search case insensitive
description: Searching for operating systems should match Operating Systems.
how: Mixed-case searches return matching posts.

title: Add loading states
description: Give users feedback while feed and event data loads.
how: Slow navigation shows a loading UI.

title: Add event calendar action
description: Let a user add an event to Google Calendar.
how: The detail page creates a valid calendar link.

title: Add help board tag filtering
description: Users need to filter questions by tag.
how: Selecting a tag only shows matching questions.

title: Add contacts search
description: The contacts page should search by department or service.
how: Typing a term filters contacts without a reload.

title: Add edit and delete controls
description: Authors need UI controls for their own posts and messages.
how: An author can edit or delete their own content.

title: Add copy link action
description: Posts need a simple copy link action.
how: The action copies a stable post URL.

title: Add chat auto scroll
description: New lounge messages should keep the newest message in view.
how: Sending a message scrolls to the newest message.

title: Add chat polling
description: Refresh the latest 50 lounge messages every five seconds.
how: A second browser sees a new message within the polling window.

title: Add server rate limits
description: All write endpoints need best-effort per-user limits.
how: Repeated writes are rejected with a clear status.

title: Complete Google OAuth callback
description: Exchange the auth code and enforce the allowed email domain.
how: Google login creates a profile and rejects disallowed domains.

title: Add storage signed uploads
description: Implement PDF and image uploads through signed Supabase URLs.
how: Valid files upload without passing through Vercel request bodies.

title: Build the admin moderation page
description: Admins need report review, deletion, and bans.
how: An admin can review a report and remove its target.

title: Replace placeholder contacts
description: Update the JSON with verified university contacts.
how: Every contact is approved by the organizer.

title: Fix README wording
description: Proofread the README and expand the incomplete section.
how: A beginner can follow every command without confusion.

title: Add privacy data deletion details
description: Explain how a student requests account and content deletion.
how: The policy clearly describes the request process.

title: Add a real favicon
description: Replace the placeholder browser icon with a campus asset.
how: The browser tab shows the approved favicon.

title: Add profile bio editing
description: Profiles need an edit form for the optional bio.
how: A signed-in owner can save a bio.

title: Add most-upvoted sort
description: Feed users should be able to sort by upvotes.
how: The sort control orders posts by upvotes.

title: Improve For You ranking
description: Prioritize branch and semester matches using a clear score.
how: Matching posts appear before unrelated posts.

title: Add upvote UI feedback
description: The count should update immediately after a successful upvote.
how: The button reflects the new count without refresh.

title: Use one shared event card
description: Remove repeated card markup by extracting a shared component.
how: Event lists use one reusable component.

title: Add API error messages to forms
description: Show server validation errors beside the form that caused them.
how: Invalid submissions produce visible, useful errors.

title: Add test setup
description: Create focused tests for validation and demo data behavior.
how: A test command runs and covers the helpers.

title: Add report buttons
description: Posts, help requests, and chat messages need report actions.
how: A signed-in user can submit a report for each content type.

title: Add banned-user enforcement
description: Banned users must not post, chat, or upload.
how: Every write endpoint rejects a banned session.

title: Add upload rights checkbox
description: Upload forms need a clear right-to-share confirmation.
how: Upload cannot start until the checkbox is selected.

title: Add Open Graph metadata
description: Shared pages need useful social preview metadata.
how: A link preview shows the app name and description.

title: Fix heading capitalization
description: Use a consistent heading style across pages.
how: Headings follow the chosen capitalization convention.
